scope: Paired workload-level resampling of endpoint scores
sampling: Each draw samples 50 workload indices with replacement; identical indices used across methods
within_cluster: Keep all four configurations and all five repeats together; no inner resampling of repeats
overall_statistic: Arithmetic mean over sampled workload clusters, equally weighted configurations, and five repeats; failed endpoints score zero
per_configuration_statistic: Same shared workload indices, using only the selected configuration and its five repeats
majority_correctness: At least 3 of 5 correct repeats. Minority-correct groups still contribute positive speedups to endpoint means.
sd: Sample SD of five aggregate repeat means; ddof=1
repeat_unit: One seed-level endpoint record within a workload-configuration pair
uncertainty_unit: Workload resampling conditional on the supplied endpoint records
